<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>
<evidence>

 "problem_statement": "Users need to connect reporting and supplier integrations to their existing policyholder records but lack clarity on how data flows and syncs. This creates uncertainty about accuracy and completeness of information across systems.",

  },

   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater automatically pulls and updates supplier contact details from integrated systems, ensuring claims handlers always have the most current information without manual entry.\", \"id\": 4129, \"name\": \"Supplier contact details\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"

Keelwater’s interface ensures quick filtering and drill-downs for efficient claim analysis.\", \"id\": 4137, \"name\": \"Reporting navigation\", \"started\": false, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 1}"
  },

   "record": "{\"id\": \"30cf8382-0725-5e19-b883-945ae35bebcd\", \"object\": \"page\", \"properties\": {\"Name\": {\"title\": [{\"plain_text\": \"Supplier directory\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"Supplier directory\"}, \"type\": \"text\"}], \"type\": \"title\"}, \"Problem\": {\"rich_text\": [{\"plain_text\": \"A searchable directory within Keelwater that lets users find and manage supplier information, including contact details, contract status, and claim history, streamlining collaboration and compliance tracking.\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"A searchable directory within Keelwater that lets users find and manage supplier information, including contact details, contract status, and claim history, streamlining collaboration and compliance tracking.\"},"

<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.

response.content: {"critique": "The problem is lack of clarity on how reporting/supplier integrations connect and sync with policyholder records. None of the five similar items address this: story 4136 (supplier address fields, in progress), 4129 (supplier contact sync, completed) covers contact detail updates, not integration/sync clarity with policyholder records; 4137 (reporting navigation, unstarted) is about UI navigation; the Supplier directory roadmap page is about searching supplier info; and 4131 (workspace administration) is unrelated. All similarity scores are very low (0.036-0.057), confirming no shipped story or roadmap item solves the same problem.", "verdict": "pass"}
